# Vendored VeilDesk client

Source: https://github.com/Cyano88/veildesk
Pinned commit: cff6dee5cff84f8381a074f87195cf8b7ca40565

These seven unmodified SDK modules comprise the client import graph. Vendoring
keeps Render deployments independent of a sibling checkout or mutable branch.
No server, wallet configuration, endpoint identity or token is included.
